goal: Integrate provider-truth continuation, exact-head CI classification and existing reusable execution authorities into one deterministic fail-closed PLAN_ONLY control-loop decision path without creating new mutation authority.
scope: consume the exact provider-truth continuation decision for the current canonical Work Unit state
consume exact-head CI inspection/classification only when a selected Work Unit has an exact bounded PR head
derive one deterministic next control-loop boundary such as wait, collect evidence, materialization planning, existing Writer Lease path or existing merge eligibility path
reference existing reusable materialization, Writer Lease and merge/Issue-close authorities without duplicating or broadening them
keep the control-loop integration PLAN_ONLY and require every mutation to remain gated by its separately authorized existing transaction
fail closed on stale main, selected Work Unit drift, PR head drift, incomplete CI inventory, authority-anchor drift or contradictory continuation state
forbidden_scope: grant Issue-create, Issue-update, branch, pull-request, provider-state, Writer Lease, workflow-rerun, merge or Issue-close authority
mutate product/runtime source or runtime state
mutate ADWF Consumer binding/provenance or the ADWF repository
perform release/tag/promotion, ruleset/policy administration, PRIVATE evidence publication or 1080/1081 lifecycle mutation
exit_criteria: one deterministic PLAN_ONLY control-loop decision is derived from fresh provider truth
selected Work Unit, NO_WORK, pending CI and classified CI failure paths are mutually exclusive and fail closed
all executable mutations remain delegated to exact existing reusable authority contracts rather than the control loop itself
unknown, stale, contradictory or incomplete provider state yields BLOCKED or WAIT rather than guessed recovery
exact-head hosted CI passes with no provider-state, ADWF, product/runtime or 1080/1081 mutation
